title: Prosecutors reportedly find secret passage to a bunker in property linked to Peña
detail: Globo's g1 (Jornal Nacional) reports that prosecutors found a secret passage leading to a bunker in a property linked to ousted president Santiago Peña. Only the headline-level summary was available to this update: the property's location, ownership details and relevance to the Ueno Bank case are not confirmed here.

title: Prosecutors open hidden vault at Peña-linked property: an empty panic room
detail: Paraguayan prosecutors opened the supposed hidden vault at a property linked to ousted president Santiago Peña in the Ueno Bank case and found it empty. Prosecutors clarified it is a panic room, not a vault, following earlier reports of a secret passage to a bunker.
